- Outcome: Invitations now uses the existing authenticated legacy API `/api/admin/onboarding-invites` for GET list and POST create/revoke/backfill/recover-intake. The view shows expiry/status/creator (missing creator -> `Not recorded`), creates optional client-email invitations, displays the generated link once from in-memory state with copy and manual-copy fallback, and never stores the link/token in localStorage, sessionStorage, cookies, URL, console or analytics. Revoke requires contextual confirmation; backfill reports updated/remaining counts; recovery requires selecting an invitation, entering an explicitly reviewed issue number and checking the confirmation box.
